text:
Situation: Hydralazine hydrochloride tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 280 units with 24.6 days of supply at current use. Corvale General holds 391 units with 29.7 days of supply. The Safecor Health label (NDC 48433004620) lists Teva Czech Industries s.r.o. Opava-Komarov as the manufacturer; that plant does not appear in FDA's establishment database.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage database does not list hydralazine hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 25 to 30 days. No FDA shortage declaration exists. The Safecor label references a manufacturer not found in FDA's establishment database. Five alternate suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels do not name plants we could verify in FDA's database.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with A-S Medication Solutions, A2A Integrated Pharmaceuticals, American Health Packaging, Aphena Pharma Solutions - Tennessee, LLC, and Ascend Laboratories, LLC to build safety stock; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to request current establishment registration and manufacturing site details from each alternate supplier before receipt; requires buyer and quality assurance approval.
3. Pharmacy director to review inventory weekly and report days-on-hand to P&T committee; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
